title: Aurum brand
description: The only file an app changes to make Aurum its own. Everything else stays core.

name.description: Used for generated Dart identifiers. Letters, digits and spaces.

hue.description: OKLCH hue of the brand colour.

chroma.description: OKLCH chroma. 0.09 is calm, 0.15+ is vivid.

lightnessLight.description: Accent lightness in light mode. Default 0.48.

lightnessDark.description: Accent lightness in dark mode. Default 0.79.

chromaDark.description: Accent chroma in dark mode. Defaults to chroma; lower it for a muted, antique dark theme.

hue.description: Hue of text and dark surfaces.

chroma.description: Tint multiplier. 0 = pure grey, 1 = default, 2 = twice as tinted.

secondary.description: A second, quieter brand colour for ornament: eyebrows, leading icons, highlights. Gold by default.

ui.description: UI font family. Inter ships with Aurum; any other font must be bundled by the app.

display.description: Font for the display, page, section and card titles. Defaults to the UI font. Fraunces ships with Aurum; any other font must be bundled by the app.

displayWeight.description: wght for title roles when a display font is set. Serifs usually want less than the UI default.

displayTracking.description: Letter spacing in em for title roles when a display font is set.

scale.description: Multiplies every corner radius. 0 = square, 1 = default, 1.5 = softer.
